cohort: 147 patients with placenta accreta spectrum disorders
finding: The combined surgical approach during cesarean delivery in patients with placenta accreta spectrum disorders resulted in reduced blood loss, transfusions, bladder injuries, hospital stay, and hysterectomy rates compared to the previous surgical technique.
mod_finding: This study found that a combined surgical approach during cesarean delivery for placenta accreta spectrum disorders was associated with a lower hysterectomy rate compared to a previous surgical technique.
